name: chest to wall handstand
description: A handstand facing the wall with the toes lightly touching it. It trains a straight stacked line and shoulder endurance.
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet against the wall.
Walk your feet up the wall and your hands toward it until your chest nearly touches it.
Lock your arms and push tall through your shoulders.
Squeeze your legs together and keep your ribs tucked.
Hold, then walk your hands out and your feet down.
